craft.name: Suppression Gloves · Attack Speed
uncertainties: Indicative CoE model: displayed probability and expected essence uses are rounded. Real spending and completed sales are not established.

The acquisition is an already fractured14% suppression rare base. Its actual asking price and gold fee need fresh market evidence; self-fracturing and any Eldritch/bench finish are outside this method.

steps.title: Roll life with the fractured suffix
steps.action: Acquire rare Dragonscale Gauntlets with at least 14% fractured Spell Suppression. Use Deafening Essence of Zeal.
steps.continueWhen: Life at least 100 with essence attack speed at least 17%.
steps.failureAction: Repeat the paid essence on the same base; only the fractured suppression is protected. Keep lower outcomes as separately priced salvage, never as matches for this SKU.
